Extended GM-NVIDIA collaboration to bring NVIDIA Omniverse/Cosmos factory digital twins into production planning and NVIDIA DRIVE AGX (1,000+ TOPS) compute into next-generation vehicles for advanced driver assistance and in-cabin experience, plus AI-powered robotics for material handling and precision welding in GM factories. [NVIDIA (Omniverse, Cosmos, DRIVE AGX, Isaac)]
deployments_detail.value: DRIVE AGX provides over 1,000 trillion operations per second (1,000+ TOPS)

deployments_detail.use: AI-generated code for GM's next-generation autonomous / Super Cruise driving software. GM's autonomy team now has the overwhelming majority of its code written by AI, with the software stress-tested in simulation environments modeling roughly 100 years of human driving per day.
deployments_detail.value: nearly 90% of autonomy-team code is AI-generated (stated by CEO Mary Barra, Q1 2026 earnings)

deployments_detail.use: AI-driven marketing transformation: GM is rebuilding its marketing operation around generative AI for content creation and media, partnering with S4 Capital's Monks to build AI-first creative and production workflows across brands. [Monks (S4 Capital)]

AI recommendation engine that helps GM's North American dealers order vehicles aligned with local demand, keeping inventories lean and strengthening pricing by matching supply to customer preferences.

Generative-design and physics-based simulation AI used across GM product engineering and design — generative geometry optimization (e.g., Corvette hatch support brackets), driver-in-the-loop and virtual calibration simulations, and design of specialized products like the NASA Artemis lunar rover. Compresses structural analysis and shortens the vehicle development cycle.
deployments_detail.value: structural design assessment cut from ~15 hours to under 1 minute; vehicle development cycle targeted from 4-5 years to ~2 years; ~2 million simulation runs weekly

deployments_detail.use: AI and robotics in manufacturing/quality: proprietary AI vision tools inspect welds and paint finishes in real time, AI detects voltage/manufacturing anomalies in battery-pack assembly, digital twins of production lines simulate setups before implementation, and collaborative robots (cobots) handle repetitive/ergonomic tasks in assembly plants.

Google Gemini conversational AI assistant deployed into millions of GM vehicles (model-year 2022 and newer, Chevrolet/GMC/Buick/Cadillac with Google built-in) via over-the-air software update, replacing Google Assistant. Enables natural multi-turn voice interaction: summarize/translate messages, multi-stop navigation, mood-based playlists, contextual Q&A, riding on GM's OnStar connected-vehicle foundation. [Google Gemini (Google Cloud)]
deployments_detail.value: millions of vehicles / all MY2022+ vehicles with Google built-in

deployments_detail.use: OnStar Interactive Virtual Assistant (IVA) — conversational AI handling non-emergency OnStar 'blue button' calls: turn-by-turn navigation, vehicle-feature and EV product questions, and detecting emergency verbal cues to route callers to human advisors. Live on 2015-MY-and-newer GM vehicles in North America. [Google Cloud Dialogflow]
deployments_detail.value: answers over 1 million owner questions per month in North America

deployments_detail.use: Internally built AI supply-chain risk-intelligence system: digitized multi-tier supplier mapping with ML, a 'Risk Intelligence' AI news scanner reading thousands of daily articles, and a monitoring dashboard flagging disruptions (hurricanes, material/rare-earth shortages, shipping delays). Predicted Hurricane Helene's impact on a NC supplier.
deployments_detail.value: prevented at least 75 factory stoppages in 2024; supplier monitoring increased tenfold since the pandemic
